Calc_E_MaxDemand: CA-E-01  Maximum demand, transformer and generator
Demand = connected load x demand factor per load classification (the same factors set in Revit by FMC_SetupElectricalSettings). kVA = kW / power factor. Plant = next standard size above kVA x margin.
Blue = input from the model schedule or the brief. Yellow = assumption the engineer confirms. Green = result. Sample values: replace per project.
Standard sizes (V: confirm with the utility and suppliers)
Check against the model (release check, STD-002 9)
Total demand load from Revit panel schedules (E10_Load_Summary)
Calc_E_VoltDrop: VD (V) = mV/A/m x Ib x L / 1000; VD % = VD / nominal voltage. Limits 3% lighting, 5% other (BS 7671 Appendix 4, V). mV/A/m from the cable manufacturer or BS 7671 tables for the installation method (V).
Blue = input from the model schedule or the brief. Yellow = assumption the engineer confirms. Green = result. Sample values: replace per project.
Calc_P_Water: CA-P-01  Water demand, storage and septic tank
Daily demand = persons x litres per person per day. Storage = demand x days of storage. Septic tank capacity C = 180P + 2000 litres (BS 6297, V), P = persons served.
Blue = input from the model schedule or the brief. Yellow = assumption the engineer confirms. Green = result. Sample values: replace per project.
Calc_P_Drainage: Qww = K x sqrt(sum of DU) (BS EN 12056-2, V). Design flow is not less than the largest single DU. DU values for System III shown; confirm the system type and values (V).
Blue = input from the model schedule or the brief. Yellow = assumption the engineer confirms. Green = result. Sample values: replace per project.
Design flow (not less than largest DU)
Calc_FP_Extinguishers: Total Class A rating >= 0.065 x floor area, and at least two Class A extinguishers per storey (BS 5306-8, V).
Blue = input from the model schedule or the brief. Yellow = assumption the engineer confirms. Green = result. Sample values: replace per project.
Calc_LP_Design: Rolling sphere radius, mesh size and typical down conductor spacing by LPS class (BS EN 62305-3 Tables 2 and 4, V). Down conductors = max(2, perimeter / spacing rounded up).
Blue = input from the model schedule or the brief. Yellow = assumption the engineer confirms. Green = result. Sample values: replace per project.
